verdict.rationale: Close is a CRM SaaS, not itself an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. Close documents a first-party MCP server at developer.close.com/mcp that gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other tools direct access to Close data. It has scoped read, write-safe and write-destructive permissions, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting, and detailed setup/tool-list documentation in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other tools direct access to Close data via the MCP server — no code required.
Close's MCP server is officially supported across the Claude ecosystem.
mcp.read — read-only access; mcp.write_safe — can read and write data; mcp.write_destructive — can read, write, and delete data
official MCP server documented at https://developer.close.com/mcp
